gbm_population_evidence.quote: Patients with histologically or cytologically-confirmed, primary malignant brain tumor with (a) failure of prior standard therapy
Cohort 1: GBM, N = up to 25 patients; Cohort 2: In addition to GBM, other primary malignant brain tumors, N = up to 15 patients.

gbm_population_flag.reason: GBM is named only as a dose-expansion cohort in the brief summary, not in conditions, title or inclusion criteria (C7), although a dedicated GBM cohort is planned.

candidate_evidence.quote: This is a phase I, open-label, multicenter clinical study to evaluate the safety, tolerability, pharmacokinetics, and preliminary anti-cancer efficacy of ABM-1310 in patients with BRAF V600-mutant relapsed and drug resistant primary malignant brain tumors.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: A Study of ABM-1310 in Patients With BRAF V600-Mutant Relapsed and Drug Resistant Primary Malignant Brain Tumors
primary malignant brain tumor with (a) failure of prior standard therapy, (b) no standard therapy available

tumour_pk_planned_evidence.quote: Exposure analysis of ABM-1310 in cerebrospinal fluid: After repeated administration of ABM-1310, the drug exposure of ABM-1310 in cerebrospinal fluid was explored when the blood concentration of ABM-1310 reached stable state.

role_evidence.quote: Subjects will be given oral dosing of ABM-1310 twice daily (BID) for 28-day cycles of continuous administration until progressive disease (PD), unacceptable toxicity, or other withdrawal criteria are met as clinically observed.

agents.drug_class_hint: investigational oral BRAF V600 inhibitor (class inferred; not stated explicitly in record)

source_quote.quote: Documentation of positive BRAF V600 mutation is required for enrollment.

coder_notes: Brain-tumour (not solid-tumour) trial, so basket false; GBM appears only as expansion Cohort 1 in the brief summary - coded mixed_glioma_gbm_named with S5 uncertain for adjudication (strict C7 reading would give not_glioblastoma/high_grade_glioma_unspecified). BRAF V600 mutation is an entry requirement for the whole trial; matched to ABM-1310, which the trial design (BRAF V600-mutant population, prior BRAF/MEK inhibitors allowed) implies is a BRAF inhibitor, though the record does not state the target. CSF exposure is an exploratory outcome -> tumour_pk_planned yes. No pharmacodynamic/target-modulation measurement planned.
